customer.business: Mitra: an AI manager (AI CMO) for Indian regional-language YouTube creators
customer.target: Indian YouTubers making videos in Hindi, Hinglish, Telugu, Tamil, Marathi, Bengali, Kannada or Malayalam, 1K to 500K subscribers, trying to grow or monetise

segments.name: Small hobby-to-serious creator (1K-10K subs, not monetised or just monetised), student or day job
Growing part-time creator (10K-100K subs, earns some AdSense or brand deals)
Full-time regional creator (100K-500K subs, YouTube is main income, may have an editor)

behaviours.name: Free-tools only
behaviours.how: Uses YouTube Studio, free vidIQ/TubeBuddy and ChatGPT; has never paid for a creator tool.

behaviours.name: Already pays for vidIQ or TubeBuddy
behaviours.how: Pays for an English tool, mostly for keywords and tags, and half-uses it.

behaviours.name: Learns from YouTube gurus
behaviours.how: Watches 'how to grow on YouTube' videos in Hindi and copies what they say.

behaviours.name: Copies what is trending
behaviours.how: Checks what big channels in their niche posted this week and makes their own version.

behaviours.name: Data-curious
behaviours.how: Opens YouTube Studio analytics daily but isn't sure what to do with the numbers.

behaviours.name: Busy, phone-only
behaviours.how: Shoots and edits on the phone; lives in WhatsApp; rarely opens a laptop.

objections: I don't want an unknown app to have access to my YouTube channel
YouTube Studio and ChatGPT already tell me this for free
Will an AI really understand my Telugu/Hindi/Kannada audience?
Brand and local deals sound great but small channels like mine never get them
I don't want an app negotiating or pitching businesses in my name
₹299 a month is a lot when my channel earns little or nothing
Affiliate links might make my audience trust me less
Too many features; I just want more views
habits: you upload one or two videos a week, edited in CapCut or VN on your phone
you check YouTube Studio first thing in the morning
your creator friends share tips in a WhatsApp group
you pay for Jio/Airtel and maybe Netflix, and nothing else online
you post Shorts because people say they grow faster
you watch Hindi 'YouTube growth tips' videos before bed

pitch:
Mitra: your AI manager for YouTube, in your language (Hindi, Kannada, Telugu, Tamil, Marathi, Bengali, Malayalam).
Connect your channel (read-only). Every week Mitra gives you the 1–3 things worth doing, with the reason from your own numbers, prepares the title, thumbnail, hook and script, and afterwards shows whether it actually beat your usual views.
It also helps you earn: affiliate products that fit your audience, and paid deals with businesses near you (shops, restaurants, coaching centres, local brands) that Mitra finds and matches to your channel. It suggests a fair rate from your real numbers and helps you negotiate. Nothing is sent or posted without your OK.
Free to start. Pro ₹299/month. On deals Mitra finds for you, a small fee is shown before you accept.
